answer: A pigment bond at the wharf stops fakes: bidding above ten units needs a pigment swatch, a client-signed color code, painted on the agent's terrace, a tiered board with one tier per month. Two random peers pick one swatch within 24 hours and ask the client to confirm it; a forged, faded, or twice-used swatch burns its 8-unit bond and clears the terrace. A courier bids free on real work, while 100 fakes need 300 clients and risk 2,400 units.
